scope: Bounded repair of the fresh-red-team G1 failure; no replacement idea generated.
executive_finding: A genuinely independent primary-buyer record was found. Dongfang Boiler's own 2023 external challenge-project notice solicited an industrial-park heat-pump solution, required its technical indicators to reach an industry-advanced level, required consortium agreements to state funding inputs, and treated bid pricing as a procurement matter. The linked final national-lab record shows that this exact buyer project was completed as a 170 C industrial steam heat-pump demonstrator and accepted after third-party measurement of steam temperature, pressure and flow, heat output, input power and COP. This is not generic host-system spend: performance measurement was an explicit acceptance dependency. Combined with the independent MIIT 2026-2028 actual-load efficiency-evaluation requirement already recorded as P5R2-CN-S13, literal G1 now passes. The buyer project and its outcome are one demand lineage, not two. The prior Tongji record remains excluded from the exact-M&V proof. Public pricing for an adjacent field HVAC energy-efficiency verification procurement exists, but no signed high-temperature steam site-access agreement or project-specific metrology quotation was found; therefore the experiment cannot receive the portfolio's under-100k decisive-experiment credit now.

prior_redteam_blocker_status.reason: The new Dongfang Boiler primary-buyer solicitation and linked third-party-tested acceptance outcome prove a paid/budgeted industrial heat-pump project whose acceptance required the exact performance-measurement job. MIIT P5R2-CN-S13 is independent of that project and supplies the second demand source.
remaining_conditions: No signed access to a 300 kW-3 MW high-temperature steam heat-pump site was found.
No project-specific quotation for steam-quality instrumentation, traceable reference calorimetry, travel, safety and seasonal coverage was found.
The US beachhead still lacks a merchant buyer and must not count.
A field benchmark against ClimaCheck Onsite, Articae PilotE2 and CVC remains to be executed.

counted_independent_demand_lineages.independence_note: R01 and R02 describe the same project and together count as one demand lineage. R01 is the primary-buyer record; R02 proves that measured performance was actually used in acceptance.

counted_independent_demand_lineages.independence_note: Official national implementation program independent of Dongfang Boiler, GIEC and Tongji.

uncounted_or_supporting_demand_records.reason: Tongji buys a 2,000-hour demonstration site and operating support, not the proposed M&V island; it is not used to close G1.

CQC proves paid field HVAC operating-efficiency verification and provides a public cost comparator, but its published scope does not establish industrial high-temperature steam-heat-pump M&V; it is not used as the exact-category primary proof.

host_spend_test.rationale: Dongfang Boiler did not merely buy a heat-pump host system. Its buyer notice required industry-advanced technical indicators, and the completed acceptance used an independent third party to measure the steam-side and electrical quantities needed to determine heat output and COP. The M&V job was therefore necessary to accept the commissioned industrial-steam heat-pump project.

closest_competitors.name: ClimaCheck Onsite / PA Pro III
closest_competitors.finding: A mature portable field analyzer already validates heat-pump performance, calculates COP/capacity/power and supports commissioning, performance inspection and energy audits. It connects in roughly an hour, supports complex templates and third-party sensors, and claims test-rig-level detail.

closest_competitors.name: Articae PilotE2 Iceberg
closest_competitors.finding: Portable hardware already measures and verifies HVAC&R performance and energy savings during commissioning, maintenance and energy audits.

closest_competitors.name: CVC field heat-pump-system acceptance
closest_competitors.finding: A domestic China incumbent already performs on-site heat-pump hot-water system acceptance covering safety, water flow and temperature, heat output, power, energy efficiency and noise.

competition_recheck.noncosmetic_wedge_that_remains: Narrow the product to high-temperature industrial steam and whole-site performance-guarantee acceptance: steam enthalpy and wetness, source and sink boundaries, all auxiliary loads, synchronized transient uncertainty, and an auditable owner/integrator acceptance dossier. This is a physical metrology-and-protocol package, not a dashboard skin.
competition_recheck.window_risk: The wedge is absorbable. ClimaCheck accepts complex templates and third-party sensors, Articae covers commissioning, and CVC has a domestic field-service route. If the proposed system cannot beat all three on steam-boundary closure, transient uncertainty, installation time and guarantee-grade reporting by 2028, kill it.

china_route_recheck.base_case: CN-only beachhead through civilian industrial heat-pump integrators, energy-service firms, industrial owners and domestic testing/calibration partners.
china_route_recheck.evidence: Dongfang Boiler issued and completed the relevant industrial-park heat-pump project with GIEC; CVC and the CQC award identify domestic field-verification capacity; commodity electrical, temperature, pressure and flow instrumentation can be sourced and calibrated locally.
required_compliance: Use China-traceable calibration and preserve raw calibration certificates.
Obtain owner authorization for site data, electrical panels, pressure ports and steam-line work.
Use qualified personnel for electrical, pressure-system and refrigerant-adjacent work.
Keep restricted-party screening and data-security review in the sales checklist even though the base case is civilian and locally sourced.

g7_recheck.precompany_2026_2029: 2026: freeze high-temperature-steam boundary and uncertainty protocol and quote instrumentation. 2027: benchmark on one authorized 300 kW-3 MW loop against a traceable reference and the named incumbents. 2028: run blinded transient/degradation trials across at least two loads and complete China calibration/safety diligence. 2029: require one paid or budgeted owner/integrator acceptance engagement; kill otherwise.
g7_recheck.named_2030_2034_trigger: The existing P5R2-CN-S12 national heat-pump action plan reaches 2030, and P5R2-CN-S13 runs through 2028 while explicitly calling for industrial heat pumps and wide-range actual-load efficiency evaluation. Those programs create a validation-to-deployment handoff; the 2030-2034 recurring acceptance market remains a scenario rather than a committed order.
g7_recheck.expected_launch_readiness: TRL 7 field-validated metrology and dossier workflow by 2030 if an industrial-steam site is secured by 2027 and a paid acceptance engagement begins by 2029.
g7_recheck.window_risk: The opportunity can be commoditized before 2030 by ClimaCheck, Articae, CVC or heat-pump OEMs. Kill by 2029-12-31 without a paid engagement and a demonstrated whole-boundary steam advantage.

experiment_recheck.design: On an authorized 300 kW-3 MW high-temperature steam heat-pump loop, compare the proposed island with traceable reference measurements and the three named competitor/service approaches; introduce blinded operating changes producing about 5% performance degradation and test whole-boundary closure, transient COP uncertainty, detection sensitivity, deployment time and report turnaround.
success_thresholds: Whole-boundary energy-balance closure <=2% at prespecified stable points.
Transient COP uncertainty <=3% over the prespecified load envelope.
>=90% sensitivity to the blinded approximately 5% degradation with prespecified false-positive control.
Installation in <2 site days and signed report within 24 hours of data close.
Materially better high-temperature steam boundary coverage than ClimaCheck, PilotE2 and CVC.

public_cost_evidence.finding: CQC's 2025 field HVAC operating-efficiency verification procurement selected three providers at CNY 150,000-200,000. This is a real field-M&V service-price comparator, not a quote for the proposed high-temperature-steam experiment.

named_access_paths_but_not_commitments: Dongfang Boiler / GIEC 170 C industrial steam heat-pump program
OYRR prototype and performance-verification factory described in the linked project record
CVC and the three CQC-selected field-verification providers
experiment_recheck.reason_credit_denied: The public comparator makes a sub-100k test plausible, but it does not quote steam-quality instrumentation, traceable reference calorimetry, site access, travel/safety or seasonal coverage for this exact experiment.

G1.rationale: Dongfang Boiler is a named primary buyer soliciting an industrial-park heat-pump project with required advanced performance and price/funding terms; linked project acceptance used third-party measurement of exact steam and electrical performance. MIIT P5R2-CN-S13 is an independent second demand source requiring industrial heat pumps and actual-load evaluation.

G2.rationale: The prior final peer-reviewed monitoring paper supports boundary discipline only. No 2-3% industrial-steam accuracy is borrowed from it.

G3.rationale: A bounded 12-month, USD 68,000 falsifier is specified. Lack of signed access and an exact quote prevents under-100k portfolio credit but does not erase the bounded experiment itself.

G4.rationale: ClimaCheck, Articae and CVC are now the named closest incumbents. High-temperature steam whole-boundary acceptance remains non-cosmetic but highly absorbable.

G5.rationale: The observables, sensors and uncertainty methods exist; failure modes are measurable and no nonexistent physics is required.

G6.rationale: A civilian China route using local instrumentation, calibration and qualified site personnel is plausible without a structurally blocked cross-border dependency.

G7.rationale: The 2026-2029 program is bounded, official 2028/2030 triggers are named, 2030 readiness is conditional, and commoditization is controlled by a 2029 kill date.

demonstrated_demand.evidence: Exact paid/budgeted buyer project and independent official evaluation program, but no merchant purchase of the startup island.

launch_window_fit_2030.evidence: Official 2028 evaluation and 2030 action-plan dates plus a 2029 kill date.

founder_skill_transfer.evidence: Generic EE/CE instrumentation, synchronization and uncertainty software transfer directly but do not solve steam metrology or site access.

revised_score.score_change_note: The repair changes G1 from FAIL to PASS and changes China countability, but demonstrated-demand raw score stays 3 because no buyer has purchased the merchant M&V island itself.
